**Clip the web's best design. Let your AI agent build from it.**

Artspo is a Chrome extension that measures the sites you save (palette, type scale, radii, shadows, and the motion a screenshot misses) into plain `clip.md` files, plus an agent skill that lets Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI or Copilot distill those clips into design languages and techniques, then make work from them. No server, no account.

This is the first packaged release.

### Install

1. Download **`artspo-0.7.1.zip`** below and unzip it somewhere permanent (not inside `~/Downloads/artspo`, where your clips go).
2. Give your agents the skill: `cd artspo && sh install.sh`
3. Open `chrome://extensions`, turn on **Developer mode**, click **Load unpacked**, and choose the `extension` folder.
4. On a site you like, press **Alt+Shift+S**.

Prefer git? `git clone https://github.com/bryfeng/artspo` works the same, and `git pull` updates it.

### Files

- `artspo-0.7.1.zip`: the whole repo (extension, skill, docs). Use this one.
- `artspo-extension-0.7.1.zip`: just the `extension/` folder, the Chrome Web Store upload.

Requires Chrome 118+ on macOS (Linux works; Windows isn't supported). [5-minute tutorial](https://github.com/bryfeng/artspo/blob/main/docs/TUTORIAL.md) · [artbook.dev](https://artbook.dev/?utm_source=github&utm_medium=release&utm_campaign=artspo)
